title: Add Notes stat card to Dashboard second row

requirements.text: Update the Dashboard page to include a new "Notes" overview stat card placed in the second row, positioned next to the existing "Meeting Attendance" stat card (so the second row contains two stat cards side-by-side below the first four cards).

quotes: Add a sixth stat card next to the Meeting Attendance card (both in the second row below the first four cards).

acceptanceCriteria: The Dashboard shows 4 stat cards in the first row and 2 stat cards in the second row.
In the second row, the Notes stat card appears next to (side-by-side with) the Meeting Attendance stat card on screen sizes where the grid supports multiple columns (e.g., sm and up).
The two second-row cards are evenly spaced using the same grid gap behavior as the other stat cards.

requirements.text: Implement the "Notes" stat card UI to match the existing stat card sizing and hover/click behavior, with these specifics: title text "Notes"; a note/document-style icon from the existing icon set; dark grey background (#374151 or #4B5563); white text for contrast; show the total global notes count across the entire app formatted like "12 notes" with the numeric count displayed large.

quotes:
The Notes card should show:
   - Title: "Notes"
   - Icon: A note or document icon
   - Total number of global notes across the entire app
   - Format like: "12 notes" with the count displayed large
   - Background color: Dark Grey (#374151 or #4B5563)
   - White text for good contrast

Make sure the Notes card:
   - Is the same size as the other stat cards
   - Has the same clickable hover effect

acceptanceCriteria: The Notes card uses the same outer classes as the other stat cards (rounded, padding, shadow, hover:shadow-xl, hover:brightness-110, cursor-pointer) so its size and hover effect match.
The Notes card background color is exactly #374151 or exactly #4B5563, and all text/icons on the card are white (or white with opacity consistent with the other cards).
The card displays the global notes total count derived from the app’s global notes data (not hard-coded).
The card displays the count in a large font, and the text shows the format "<count> note"/"<count> notes" (e.g., "12 notes").

requirements.text: Wire the Notes stat card to navigate to the Notes page route "/notes" when clicked, using the same routing approach as the other dashboard stat cards.

quotes: When the Notes card is clicked, navigate to the Notes page (/notes).

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking anywhere on the Notes stat card navigates to /notes.
Navigation uses the existing <Link to="/notes"> pattern consistent with other dashboard cards.

requirements.text: Fetch the global notes list on the Dashboard using the existing global notes query hook and use it to compute the Notes stat card total; include the notes query loading state in the Dashboard loading gate so the card does not render stale/undefined counts while data is still loading.

quotes: Total number of global notes across the entire app

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard uses the existing global notes React Query hook to obtain the notes array and compute the total count as notes.length.
The Dashboard loading spinner state accounts for the global notes query loading state in the same way it already accounts for other dashboard data queries.
No other Dashboard sections (cards, recent activity, alerts) change behavior or content aside from adding the Notes stat card.

constraints: Keep all existing Dashboard behavior and styling unchanged except for adding the new Notes stat card and adjusting the second-row layout to accommodate it.
Do not edit files in frontend immutable paths (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*).
nonGoals: Do not change the Notes page functionality, filters, CRUD behavior, or styling.
Do not add new backend endpoints or modify backend data schema/state for this change.
Do not change the existing Meeting Attendance stat card calculations, styling, color, or navigation.
